name: com.redbricklane.zapr.videosdk.vastplayer.activity.ZaprVASTActivity
description: When the Zapr Video SDK starts a VAST ad, this Activity plays the video, tracks viewing progress, and lets the viewer visit the advertiser. It also reports whether the ad was dismissed or reached viewing milestones.
disableEffect: Zapr video ads cannot play or open their advertiser pages, and rewards for watching those ads will no longer be granted.
